# TEVV Document — Skeleton

**Status:** To be completed after master report is finalized.

This document provides validation metrics and evaluation results per NIST AI Risk Management Framework (RMF) guidelines. All source material is in `archive/research_notes/` (former Reports 01–03).

## Planned Sections

### 1. Inter-Rater Agreement Analysis

- All kappa scores (Cohen's, Fleiss') across pipeline stages
- Raw agreement percentages
- Stratified agreement by survey, topic, barrier type
- The kappa paradox: interpretation challenges when one category dominates

*Source data:* `output/report_03/analysis/stage2_agreement_metrics.json`

### 2. Arbitration Methodology and Results

- Arbitration protocol (independent models, cross-vendor)
- Pre- vs post-arbitration agreement improvement
- Quality gate definitions and pass/fail results
- Coverage analysis (two-way vs three-way arbitration)

*Source data:* `output/report_03/analysis/stage3_arbitration_metrics.json`

### 3. Multi-Model Behavioral Analysis

- Synthesis rates by vendor (Google ~7%, OpenAI ~59%, Anthropic ~77%)
- Pro-self bias detection
- Deferential vs synthesizing arbitration patterns
- Family bias analysis

*Source data:* `output/report_03/analysis/stage3_arbitration_metrics.json`, `output/report_03/visuals/`

### 4. Classification Validation (Report 01)

- Dual-model agreement on topic/subtopic classification
- Topic distribution consistency across models
- Confidence calibration

*Source data:* `output/report_01/comparison/agreement_summary.csv`

### 5. Construct Validity

- Sanity checks: demographics score ~100% consolidable
- Barrier distribution matches domain expectations
- Cross-survey rate stability

*Source data:* `output/report_03/analysis/stage4_construct_validity.md`

### 6. Cost-Quality Analysis

- API cost per stage
- Quality vs cost tradeoffs across model tiers
- Efficiency comparison with manual methods

*Source data:* `output/report_03/analysis/stage4_cost_quality_summary.md`
